ability.name: Soul-Heart
ability.note: This Pokémon deals +10 damage for each time one of your Pokémon has been knocked out. This Pokémon can remove Curse markers, Cracked markers, and special conditions by tagging.

wheel.name: Dazzling Gleam
wheel.note: *Opposing Pokémon adjacent to this Pokémon spin, and if they spin a Gold Attack then they are knocked out.

wheel.name: Fleur Cannon
wheel.note: *If the battle opponent is knocked out, this Pokémon returns to its start-of-the-duel state (excluding evolution and special conditions).

wheel.name: Shift Gear
wheel.note: Until the end of the duel, this Pokémon's MP becomes 3 and its Blue Attacks become Misses.
